limits: Geometry is the Materials Project parent structure; 3DSC adds the doping artificially.
3DSC can match a family to the wrong polymorph. Two large cases are corrected by data/training/cuprate-parent-overrides/rules.json; smaller ones may remain.
Doping is a formula-level average over all copper atoms, with nominal valences and nominal oxygen.
These are empirical correlations from the literature, not a mechanism.

parent_structure_rules.matched_structure: La2CuO4, I4/mmm, T' structure (Nd2CuO4 type): no apical oxygen, Cu-O 2.00 A
parent_structure_rules.reason: 3DSC matched the whole La2CuO4 family to Materials Project's lowest-energy entry, which is the T' polymorph. Hole-doped La2-x(Sr,Ba,Ca,Na,K)xCuO4 and oxygen-doped La2CuO4+d crystallise in the T structure, which has apical oxygens. Lanthanide-substituted, electron-doped members (La2-xCexCuO4) really are T' and keep the matched structure.
parent_structure_rules.replacement_structure: La2CuO4, I4/mmm, T structure (K2NiF4 type): two apical oxygens at 2.46 A, Cu-O 1.91 A

parent_structure_rules.matched_structure: SrCuO2, Cmcm: double Cu-O chains, no CuO2 plane
parent_structure_rules.reason: 3DSC matched Sr1-xLnxCuO2 to the ambient-pressure chain polymorph of SrCuO2. The lanthanide-doped superconductors are the high-pressure infinite-layer phase. Rows without a substituent keep the matched structure because the formula alone does not say which phase was made.
parent_structure_rules.replacement_structure: SrCuO2, P4/mmm, infinite-layer structure: CuO2 planes separated only by Sr
